versions.content: A defaultValue that is specified in the ECU Configuration Parameter Definition may be used as the initial value in the ECU Configuration Value description If a defaultValue is specified in the ECU Configuration Param- eter Definition that given value can be used as the initial value of the according EcucParameterValue for the ECU Configuration Value description as explained by [TPS_ECUC_01019].
